Curated by Shubhi Kapoor — personal-stylist brand identity (2020).

An identity for a personal styling label, built on a clean wire-hanger mark cradling a hand-script 'Curated'. Soft terracotta and sage, washy palm leaves, and a set of launch social templates — a wardrobe's worth of polish for a one-person studio.

Brand identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·69.
